account_lead: Follow your orders, manage your plan and book a pickup.
account_state_errorTitle: We could not load this page
account_state_errorBody: Check your internet and try again.
account_error_network: We cannot reach Dress Doctor. Check your internet and try again.
account_error_sessionEnded: You have been logged out. Please log in again.
account_error_invalid: Please check what you wrote and try again.
account_error_pickupNotPending: We have already confirmed this pickup, so you cannot cancel it here. Please message us on WhatsApp.
account_error_planChanged: Your plan was just changed. We have updated this page. Please check it and try again.
account_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account_contact_change: To change a phone number or an email, message us on WhatsApp. We will do it with you.
account_contact_unchecked_title: We have not checked your phone number
account_contact_unchecked_body: You typed it when you signed up. Message us on WhatsApp and we will check it with you.
account_prefs_language_hint: We write to you on WhatsApp and by email in this language.
account_prefs_notify_label: Messages about my orders and pickups
account_prefs_notify_hint: We tell you when a pickup is confirmed or your clothes are ready.
account_prefs_address_hint: We use this when you book a pickup. You can change it each time.
account_prefs_address_placeholder: Street, area and a place we can find, such as near Carrefour…
account_prefs_leave_body: You have changes that are not saved. If you leave now, they are lost.
account_orders_empty_body: When we collect your clothes, your order will show here.
account_order_expected: We plan to bring it back on {date}.
account_order_cancelled: This order was cancelled. If you have a question, message us on WhatsApp.
account_order_noItems: The list of your clothes will show here once we have counted them.
account_order_covered: These clothes are covered by your plan.
account_order_notFound_body: Check the order code, or go back to your orders.
account_plan_meter: What is left of your plan
account_plan_pendingNote: We have your request. We will call you soon to confirm your plan.
account_plan_pausedNote: Your plan is paused. Start it again when you are ready.
account_plan_empty_body: A plan gives you a set amount of laundry each month for one price.
account_plan_pause_body: Your plan stops until you start it again. You can start it again at any time.
account_plan_resume_body: Your plan will be active again.
account_plan_cancel_body: Your plan will end now, and you will lose what is left of it. You cannot undo this. To have a plan again, you will need to ask for a new one.
account_plan_withdraw_body: We will not set up this plan. You can ask for a plan again at any time.
account_plan_endedDate: Your plan ended because its date came and a renewal was not confirmed.
account_plan_endedUsedUp: Your plan ended early because you used everything it included.
account_plan_renewDue: Your plan ends on {date}. Tell us if you want to renew it.
account_plan_renewConfirmed: You have confirmed your renewal. It starts on {date}.
account_plan_feePaid: The fee for this period is paid.
account_plan_feeEarlier: Counting earlier periods, you owe {total} in total.
account_plan_feeWaived: Nothing is owed for this period: the fee was waived when the plan was cancelled.
account_plan_feePartial: You have paid {paid} of the fee. {left} is still to pay.
account_plan_feeUnpaid: The fee for this period is not paid yet. {left} to pay.
account_plan_renew_bodyEnded: Your plan starts again straight away. You can pay the fee afterwards.
account_plan_renew_bodyRunning: Your next period starts when this one ends. You can pay the fee afterwards.
account_pickups_lead: Your requests for us to collect your clothes.
account_pickups_empty_body: Book a pickup and we will collect your clothes from your door.
account_pickups_cancel_body: We will not come to collect your clothes. You can book another pickup at any time.
